sql:
-- Check driver_standings for 2024's last race
SELECT r.race_id, r.year, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE r.year = 2024
ORDER BY ds.points DESC
LIMIT 3
